contentPattern.structure: tab label + tab content (rich default content) per row

suitableFor: adventure/product detail tab switchers (Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring)

similarityEvaluation.reason: The project has NO tabs block (base=tabs). The only related interactive block is accordion-faq (base=accordion), but that is the wrong interaction model — the source is a genuine role=tablist tab switcher, not collapsible Q&A, and accordion-faq's own metadata explicitly says tabbed switching should not reuse it. Different base block and interaction pattern → score far below 0.8, new variant created from the vanilla Block Collection tabs block.
